column1: #origin.hypothesis=The queued Opbox-style disk synchronization idea is not admissible unless it beats or replaces the existing board CRDT with a named consumer and measurable convergence predicate.
#origin.question=Does the CRDT study identify a bounded consumer and a real convergence artifact beyond the current G-Set board, or should it be deferred?

#origin.acceptance=Inspect the existing review and run its stated consumer/convergence predicate; require a named current consumer and a nonempty verification artifact before any implementation task is proposed.
#origin.feedback=If no bounded consumer exists, close as deferred with the review artifact; otherwise hand only the smallest verified follow-up to the steward.

column4: Reconcile the queued CRDT study against the existing Blocklace review, price the material with its consumer predicate, and record either a durable deferral or a bounded steward task without adding a second synchronization substrate.
